paragraphs.text: Last Sunday, Lily and Tom went to Ocean Park. They walked to the big blue tank. A green sea turtle swam near them.
paragraphs.translation: 上周日，莉莉和汤姆去了海洋公园。他们走到那个蓝色的大水槽前。一只绿海龟游到他们身边。

paragraphs.text: The turtle was slower than the fish. But it was much bigger and older. It looked at Lily with kind eyes.
paragraphs.translation: 这只海龟比鱼游得慢。但它大得多，也老得多。它用温和的眼神看着莉莉。

paragraphs.text: Then they saw something sad. A plastic bag floated near the turtle. The turtle thought it was food. Lily felt worried and a little angry.
paragraphs.translation: 接着他们看到了一件让人难过的事。一个塑料袋漂到海龟旁边。海龟以为那是吃的。莉莉又担心又有点生气。

paragraphs.text: A kind worker came to help. She took the bag out quickly. The water looked cleaner than before. The turtle swam away, happy and free.
paragraphs.translation: 一位好心的工作人员过来帮忙。她很快把袋子捞了出去。海水看起来比以前干净了。海龟游走了，又快活又自在。

paragraphs.text: Lily and Tom learned a big lesson. We must keep the sea clean. Small hands can make a big difference.
paragraphs.translation: 莉莉和汤姆学到了重要的一课。我们一定要让大海保持干净。小小的双手也能带来大大的改变。

paragraphs.text: Now they carry cloth bags to the beach. They pick up rubbish every weekend. The ocean is happier than last year.
paragraphs.translation: 现在他们去海边会带上布袋。每个周末他们都去捡垃圾。大海比去年更快乐了。
